title: Station state post with the boot id and the wall steps
description: Designed (docs/native/capture-split.md 4.3 "Clocks", 4.5, 11 H1d, #773), not implemented. Today's body of POST /api/station/state (station-state.schema.json, as built and not touched) plus two optional keys the station does not send yet: `boot`, the boot id the post was made under, and `wall_steps`, the wall steps capture counted since that boot (from its status file). With both on every post, each `hub.skew` sample carries them, and the hub may place a call's start by the skew only with samples of the call's own boot that bracket its start with no wall step since (a reboot always counts as one). The default, until a station reports both: the skew path is unavailable, and a flagged call the hub cannot place by its boot age alarms with the label "emergency still set after All clear" (the radio maintainers add both keys to the state post in a small PR of their own, before the capture split). Both keys are optional, so every post a station sends today is valid here.

boot.description: The boot id (`/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id`) the post was made under. Opaque: compared for equality only.

wall_steps.description: The wall steps capture counted since boot `boot` (a change of wall - boot clock by more than 5 s between samples at most 5 s apart), a count. It only rises within one boot; a new `boot` starts it again.
